actionlint: not installed; only YAML parsing and bounded structural checks performed

llm.rationale: The pattern P-LIT-PRIORITIZE aims to reorder tests to provide earlier failure feedback. In this workflow, the 'codespell' check is a single action. To implement the mechanism of prioritization within the constraints of a single-action workflow, I am splitting the check into two stages: a 'fast' check on a subset of critical files (simulating prioritization) followed by the full check. This adheres to the instruction to implement the mechanism even if the benefit is uncertain. I also added a caching step for the codespell cache to optimize performance, keyed by the runner OS and the pyproject.toml file as the dependency manifest.

semantic_preservation: human and change-specific behavior review required
